articles.summary: MALMÖ, Sweden, May 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY) (“Oatly” or the “Company”), the world’s original and largest oat drink company, today announced the results of its Annual General Meeting of shareholders (the “AGM”) held on May 20, 2026.
articles.title: Oatly Group AB (publ) Announces Results of 2026 Annual General Meeting
